data.name: Frank
data.message: Body in medbay! Eve just arrived from upper_engine

I found Frank's body in medbay — just now when I walked in. My route was lower_engine → storage → medbay. 

Important: I saw Charlie in storage from tick 3 through tick 5. At tick 3, Charlie came INTO storage FROM medbay. That puts Charlie coming out of the room where Frank ended up dead. Then Charlie left storage toward lower_engine around tick 6.

I didn't see anyone else on my route. I'd really like to hear where Alice, Bob, and Eve were, and Charlie needs to explain what he was doing in medbay before storage.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical. I was in medbay around tick 3-5 and I saw Frank there alive — in fact, I watched Frank enter medbay from storage at tick 3. So Frank was alive in medbay at tick 5 when I left toward electrical.

That's important context for Diana's timeline: Charlie was in storage from tick 3-5 according to Diana, but Charlie supposedly came from medbay at tick 3. I was in medbay at tick 3 and I don't recall seeing Charlie there — though I entered around that time so I might have just missed him leaving.

After I left medbay for electrical around tick 5-6, someone else must have entered and killed Frank. Diana found the body coming from storage direction. I'd really like to hear from Charlie about his medbay visit, and from Alice and Eve about where they were after tick 5, since that's the kill window.

My route was navigation → security → weapons. I went straight to the right side of the map the whole time, nowhere near medbay or storage. I didn't encounter a single player on my route — no one was on the east side with me, which honestly is a bit frustrating because I have no one to vouch for me.

Listening to Diana and Bob: the kill window is after tick 5 in medbay. Bob confirms Frank was alive in medbay at tick 5. Diana found the body coming from storage. So the killer entered medbay between tick 5 and when Diana arrived.

Bob says he left medbay toward electrical around tick 5-6 — that means Bob was one of the last people with Frank alive. Bob could have doubled back, but electrical doesn't directly connect to medbay, so that's harder.

Charlie's the big question mark. Diana saw him come FROM medbay into storage at tick 3, but Bob was in medbay at tick 3 and doesn't remember Charlie. That's a potential contradiction — either Bob missed him or Charlie's timing is off. But Charlie left storage toward lower_engine at tick 6, which means Charlie wasn't the one who entered medbay during the kill window from storage.

Wait — Diana came from storage to medbay and found the body. Could Diana herself have killed Frank? She's the reporter, and she had direct access. I want to hear Charlie and Eve before deciding. Right now I'm watching Diana and Bob both carefully.

Okay, let me clear some things up because Bob and Diana both have my timeline a bit off.

My route was medbay → storage → lower_engine. I started in medbay early — I was there before Bob arrived. I left medbay toward storage around tick 3, which is probably why Bob doesn't remember seeing me — we crossed paths as I was leaving and he was entering. Frank was alive in medbay when I left.

I was in storage from roughly tick 3-4 through tick 6, then moved to lower_engine. I saw Diana in storage with me — she entered storage from lower_engine at tick 3, and I saw her there ticks 4, 5, and 6. 

Now here's the thing that's bugging me about Diana's story: Diana says her route was lower_engine → storage → medbay, and that she found Frank's body in medbay "just now." But I was with Diana in storage through tick 6. That means Diana left storage for medbay AFTER tick 6 — which puts her arriving in medbay right in the kill window Bob described (after tick 5-6 when Bob left).

Bob left medbay toward electrical at tick 5-6. Frank was alive then. Diana arrives in medbay from storage shortly after — and finds Frank dead. Either Diana killed Frank on arrival, or someone else slipped in between Bob leaving and Diana arriving.

Alice is on the east side with no alibi but also no easy access. Eve hasn't spoken yet — I really want to hear her route. But Diana being the one to arrive at the body right after Bob left is suspicious to me. I'm leaning Diana, but let's hear Eve first.

Okay, listen carefully because my information is important.

My route was upper_engine → medbay. I went to upper_engine first to start on engine work, then moved through the corridor to medbay. I arrived in medbay at tick 6 and I saw Frank there — alive. I didn't stay long because I was planning to head through to do more tasks, and Frank was alone when I left.

Here's what concerns me: Bob says he left medbay toward electrical at tick 5-6. I arrived at tick 6 and Frank was alive. So the kill window is AFTER tick 6, which lines up exactly with when Diana would have arrived from storage according to Charlie's timeline.

Charlie's account of being in storage with Diana through tick 6 is the key piece here. If Charlie is telling the truth, Diana arrived in medbay right after I left, found Frank alone, and killed him — then "reported" to look innocent. That's a classic reporter play.

I didn't see Diana on my route at all, and I didn't see Charlie. I only saw Frank, alive, in medbay at tick 6.

Bob's story is consistent with mine — Frank was alive when Bob left, and still alive when I passed through. Alice was on the east side, no access. Charlie was in storage with Diana as a witness.

That leaves Diana as the one who entered medbay during the kill window. I'm voting Diana.

Wait, everyone needs to slow down here. I already spoke first and laid out my observations honestly. Let me respond to what's been said because there's a coordinated pile-on happening.

First: Charlie's timeline directly contradicts mine in a critical way. Charlie says he was in storage "through tick 6" with me as a witness. That's FALSE. I saw Charlie LEAVE storage toward lower_engine at tick 6 — he wasn't with me through tick 6, he left at tick 6. And I left storage for medbay right after. So Charlie is stretching his presence in storage to make my arrival in medbay look later than it was.

Second: Eve claims she was in medbay at tick 6 and saw Frank alive. But Bob says he was in medbay until tick 5-6 and Eve wasn't mentioned. And I never saw Eve anywhere. Eve coming from upper_engine to medbay — that path goes right through the medbay area. Eve had direct access and is the ONLY person claiming to be the last one to see Frank alive.

Think about it: Eve's "I saw Frank alive at tick 6 and left" is unverifiable and conveniently places the kill window right when I'd arrive. That's the actual classic Duck play — be the last to see the victim alive, then frame the reporter.

Why would I report a body I just killed? I'd have walked away. I reported because I found Frank dead.

I'm highly suspicious of Eve. Charlie's timeline shift is also concerning — he may be coordinating or just mistaken, but Eve is the one with means, opportunity, and an unverifiable alibi placing her at the scene last. I'm voting Eve.

I already shared my route earlier, so let me focus on what's developed.

Key point: I was in medbay ticks 3-5 and only saw Frank. I did NOT see Charlie in medbay at tick 3 — Charlie claims we "crossed paths" as he left and I entered, which is possible but unverifiable. I also did NOT see Eve in medbay. If Eve arrived at tick 6, I'd already left for electrical, so that's consistent with my timeline — I can't confirm or deny Eve was there.

What I can say: Frank entered medbay from storage at tick 3, and was alive when I left around tick 5-6 heading to electrical.

Now on Diana vs Eve: Diana's counter-argument has a problem. She says Charlie "left storage at tick 6" and she left "right after" — but that still puts Diana arriving in medbay at tick 7-8, which IS the kill window. Eve claims to have left medbay at tick 6 with Frank alive. If Eve is telling the truth, Diana is the killer. If Eve is lying, Eve is the killer.

The tiebreaker is Charlie's testimony placing Diana in storage through tick 6. Charlie has no reason to lie about that, and Diana herself confirms she was in storage with Charlie. So Diana arrived in medbay AFTER Eve's claimed exit.

I'm leaning Diana, but I want to see if anyone can corroborate Eve being in upper_engine or in the medbay corridor. Right now Diana arriving at the body immediately after the kill window is the strongest signal.

I already gave my route and initial thoughts — navigation → security → weapons, east side the whole time, no encounters. So I'm focused on the medbay timeline now.

Listening to this round of speeches, here's where I land:

The critical question is who was in medbay last with Frank alive. Bob left at tick 5-6. Eve claims she arrived at tick 6 and saw Frank alive. Diana arrived from storage after tick 6 and found him dead.

Diana's defense against Eve is interesting but has a hole: Diana says Eve's alibi is "unverifiable" — but Diana's own claim of finding the body is equally unverifiable. The reporter advantage is real.

The strongest anchor we have is Charlie and Diana mutually confirming each other in storage through tick 6. That's two-way verification. So Diana was demonstrably in storage until tick 6, then went to medbay.

If Eve is telling the truth about leaving medbay at tick 6 with Frank alive, then Diana walked in and killed him. If Eve is lying, then Eve killed Frank before tick 6 and Diana found the body.

Here's what tips me: Eve coming from upper_engine to medbay is a clean single-room path. She'd have arrived, and if she killed Frank, why not stay quiet and let someone else find the body? Reporting is risky, yes, but so is being the "last to see alive."

Honestly, I think it's between Diana and Eve, and I lean slightly Diana because she's the one who arrived right at the body. But I'm not certain. I want to hear how Charlie responds to Diana's claim that he's "stretching" his storage timeline — that's the pivot point.

Leaning Diana, but open to Eve.

Alright, let me address Diana's accusation directly because it matters.

Diana says I'm "stretching" my storage timeline. Let me be precise: I saw Diana in storage at ticks 4, 5, AND 6. She was there at tick 6 — I'm certain. Whether she left "right at tick 6" or "right after tick 6," the point stands: Diana arrived in medbay AFTER Bob left and AFTER Eve claims to have left. That puts her squarely in the kill window.

Diana's counter is to attack Eve's alibi as "unverifiable" — but here's the thing: Diana and I both confirm each other in storage through tick 6. That's the most solid two-way confirmation in this meeting. Diana CANNOT deny being in storage with me, because she already used me as her own alibi reference in her first speech. She can't have it both ways.

Eve coming from upper_engine to medbay is a clean path. If Eve killed Frank, she'd have no reason to volunteer "I was the last to see him alive" — that's painting a target on herself. Meanwhile Diana arriving at the body and immediately reporting is exactly the play to control the narrative.

Diana's pivot to accusing Eve feels like deflection. The timeline points to Diana: she left storage at tick 6, she arrived in medbay during the kill window, and she "found" the body.

I'm voting Diana.

The momentum is clearly on Diana, and I've already made my case. Let me reinforce briefly and lock this in.

Charlie just nailed the key point: he and Diana mutually confirm each other in storage through tick 6. That's the most solid two-way verification in this meeting, and Diana herself used Charlie as her alibi in her opening. She can't now turn around and call Charlie's timeline "stretched" — that's her own anchor.

Diana's defense against me boils down to "Eve's alibi is unverifiable." But that's true of almost everyone's solo movements this round — including hers. The difference is: I voluntarily told you I was the last to see Frank alive, knowing it puts heat on me. A Duck doesn't volunteer that information; a Duck stays quiet and hopes someone else gets blamed. I told you because it's the truth and it matters for the timeline.

Bob left medbay around tick 5-6. I arrived at tick 6, Frank was alive, I moved on. Diana arrived from storage right after — and "found" the body. That's the kill window, and Diana is the only person who fits it.

Alice was east the whole time. Bob's timeline is consistent. Charlie and Diana confirm each other in storage until tick 6. I came from upper_engine. The only person who arrived in medbay during the kill window is Diana.

I'm voting Diana.

data.name: Eve
data.message: Hey Charlie, just passing through - heading to nav

I found Alice's body in weapons just now. Here's my route this round: oxygen → upper engine → lower engine → storage → navigation → security → weapons. I saw Bob in security at tick 28, and then at tick 31 I watched Eve leave security heading to navigation. I came from security into weapons and found Alice dead.

So the question is who was in weapons recently. I didn't see Eve or Bob go that way — Eve went the opposite direction toward navigation. With only 3 of us left (me, Bob, Eve) and one being the Duck, I'm very interested to hear where Bob and Eve have been. Eve moving away from security right before I found a body two rooms over is worth examining, but Bob being in security and able to reach weapons is also possible. Let's hear them out.

This is bad — I need to handle this carefully. Charlie saw me come from weapons direction essentially, and I did kill Alice in weapons. I need to deflect onto Bob.

Let me think: Charlie's route ends weapons. Charlie said they saw me leave security to navigation at tick 31, but my actual route shows I went security at 31 (after cafeteria→weapons→security). Charlie's claim about seeing me go to navigation is wrong or a lie. I should challenge this carefully without seeming defensive.

Actually wait — Charlie reported the body. Charlie could be the Duck framing me. Charlie's route goes THROUGH weapons last. Charlie was IN weapons when they "found" the body. That's classic killer-reporter behavior.

Let me push hard on Charlie.

"Hold on, Charlie — your story has a problem. You say you saw me 'leave security heading to navigation' at tick 31, but I was never in navigation at tick 31. My route was: weapons → security → navigation early on, then I came back through security → electrical → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security. I was in security at tick 31, yes, but I didn't go to navigation from there — I'd already been to navigation way earlier.

More importantly: YOU are the one who ended up in weapons with the body. You're the reporter. Your own route puts you walking INTO weapons where Alice was killed. The classic move is to kill and report to look innocent.

I was in weapons earlier — I'll admit that, I passed through around tick 29 and saw Alice there alive. She was fine when I left toward security. Someone killed her after that, and Charlie, by your own admission, you walked right into weapons next.

Bob, where were you? Because between me and Charlie, Charlie is the one standing over the body."

Okay, this is critical — I'm the deciding voice. Let me lay out what I know clearly.

My route this round: storage → lower engine → upper engine → oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation. I was in weapons myself earlier in the round, before tick 28. Alice was NOT in weapons when I passed through — I would have seen her. Then I went to security, where Charlie saw me at tick 28. Charlie entered security FROM navigation at tick 28 — I witnessed that myself, which matches Charlie's story.

Then I left security and went to navigation, where I've been since. I never saw Eve this entire round.

Now here's the key thing: Eve, you just said you "passed through weapons around tick 29 and saw Alice there alive." But if you were in weapons at tick 29, and Charlie entered weapons from security shortly after and found Alice dead — that's a very tight window. You're admitting to being the last person with Alice alive in weapons.

Also, Eve, your story is internally messy. You say Charlie's claim about you going to navigation at tick 31 is wrong, but then you describe a route that loops back through weapons and security multiple times — that's a lot of movement to verify.

Charlie's account is consistent with what I personally witnessed (Charlie coming from navigation into security at tick 28). Eve places herself in weapons with Alice right before the murder.

I'm voting Eve.

Thanks Bob — that lines up exactly with what I saw too. You came from the cafeteria side into security and I came in from navigation, which is why we crossed paths at tick 28.

To clarify for Eve: I didn't say you were IN navigation at tick 31. I said I watched you LEAVE security heading toward navigation at tick 31. I was standing in security when you walked out down that corridor. That's a direct eyewitness observation, not a guess.

And Eve, you just admitted you were in weapons at tick 29 with Alice alive. The only people who could have been in weapons between then and when I found her are you or Bob. Bob's account matches mine and puts him in security then navigation — nowhere near weapons after tick 28. You're the one with the window, and your story about "passing through" weapons keeps shifting.

Bob and I can vouch for each other at security. That leaves Eve. I'm voting Eve.

Bob, Charlie — I hear you both, but let's slow down because the math here matters a lot.

Bob, you say you went cafeteria → weapons → security. Charlie, you say you came navigation → security and met Bob there at tick 28. Fine. But Bob, you just admitted you were in weapons before security. That means YOU were also in weapons during the window Alice could have been killed. You're saying Alice wasn't there when you passed through — but that's your word alone. No one can verify that.

I was in weapons at tick 29 and Alice was alive. I went to security after. Charlie, you say you watched me leave security toward navigation at tick 31 — but I was in security at tick 31 and stayed there. If you actually saw me walk out toward navigation, you're either mistaken or fabricating an eyewitness detail to pin me down. That's a serious thing to invent.

Here's what bothers me most: you two are vouching for each other very neatly. "We were together at security, so it must be the third person." That's exactly the setup a Duck pair would build. And Charlie, you walked INTO the room with the body. Reporter-killer is the oldest play in the book.

I didn't kill Alice. I'm not going to flip on this. If you vote me out and tasks don't complete, you'll know — but by then it's too late. Look at Charlie ending the round standing over the body.

Final word from me before we vote.

Eve, you're trying to muddy the water but the timeline doesn't work for you. Yes, I was in weapons — but I passed through BEFORE tick 28 on my way to security, and Alice wasn't there. You yourself just said Alice was alive in weapons at tick 29. That means Alice was killed AFTER tick 29, which puts me in the clear because I was already in security with Charlie at tick 28 and then went to navigation.

You're the only person who places themselves in weapons with Alice alive in that critical window. Charlie came into weapons from security AFTER that, where I had just seen him. The window for the kill is squarely on you.

Also, Charlie's eyewitness that you walked out of security toward navigation at tick 31 — you're calling that a fabrication, but it's a very specific claim. If Charlie wanted to frame you, he'd invent something much cleaner than a direction-of-travel detail.

I'm sticking with my vote. Eve.
